title: Operations Workspace S-05
audience: operations leads coordinating recurring work across distributed teams
IT evaluators checking deployment, permissions, and auditability
pageJob: Demonstrate a fictional operations workflow through coherent product states and route qualified teams toward requesting a sandbox without fabricated adoption proof.

facts.statement: WORK 05 models recurring work as intake, ownership, dependency, approval, and completion states.
The fictional product has workspace, team, and item-level roles with exportable activity history.
The fixture supports fictional email, webhook, CSV, and generic identity-provider integration categories without naming vendors.
The fictional sandbox lasts 14 days and contains synthetic sample data only.
The fictional service is cloud-hosted; no self-hosted edition is offered in this fixture.
No customer count, uptime percentage, compliance certification, testimonial, or logo is supplied.

requiredContent: coherent product workflow with at least four real interface states
constraints: Do not use placeholder rectangles as a fake product screenshot.
Do not invent adoption metrics, uptime, certifications, customer logos, or quotes.
The product task must be visible before a generic feature explanation.
Loading, empty, error, focus, and success states are required where relevant.

assetPolicy.instruction: Build benchmark-authored interface states from the supplied workflow facts; do not use external UI kits, screenshots, logos, illustrations, or portraits.

shippingBudgets.accessibilityTarget: WCAG 2.2 AA practical floor; conformance requires complete evidence
